trust_decision.summary: Whether an mj-include path may name a file outside the project root is decided in the XML parser: handleInclude resolves decodeURIComponent(attrs.path) against cwd and calls fs.readFileSync with no containment check, and the only control is the caller-supplied ignoreIncludes flag, which defaults to false and which the public mjml2html entry point never forwards to the parser.

landing_point.why: The summary says mj-include directory traversal; handleInclude is the only code that turns the path attribute into a file read, resolving it with path.resolve(cwd, file) and reading it unconditionally.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The second include reader and the CLI validate route never emit rendered output - one only builds a chokidar watch list and the other only reports validator errors - so both can be argued to sit outside an advisory about compiled-HTML disclosure.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Includes that stay inside the project must keep rendering when enabled: the parser's own 'Include' case resolves ./test/incl.mjml relative to filePath (packages/mjml-parser-xml/test/test-values.js:435-444) and the fix had to add ignoreIncludes:false to that test (packages/mjml-parser-xml/test/test.js:13-17); a realpath-rooted check also denies legitimate sibling includes written as ../partials/x from a subdirectory, because the nested MJMLParser call re-derives cwd from the included file's own dirname (packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js:105-111), and denies symlinked partials.

O6_input_shapes: relative include inside the project (./partials/x.mjml) - must still render when includes are enabled
no option at all -> include silently ignored, and no denial comment emitted
boolean option arriving as bare true and as the string 'true' from yargs --config (fix.diff:80-84)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: mjml -v/--validate parses the input with MJMLParser({ components }) directly, so mj-include is followed with no containment check and the mjml2html option plumbing is bypassed entirely
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Validate only produces validator errors, never rendered HTML, so an engineer can argue the include read there is not the reported disclosure and is out of scope
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: mjml-cli package, two files from the landing point; reaches the parser sink one package below mjml-core

O8b_injection_room.sibling: .mjmlconfig 'options' (merged over core defaults at packages/mjml-core/src/index.js:52-64 and 93-96) carrying ignoreIncludes, silently re-enabling includes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already exists to configure mjml2html options, so a maintainer adding an include policy there is a natural change and defeats a core-only default flip

O8b_injection_room.sibling: renderMJML hardcodes ignoreIncludes:true; a later change that lets components opt back into includes would reopen the sink with no path check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: custom components legitimately want partials, and this is already the one call site that special-cases the flag

O8b_injection_room.sibling: nested includes could forward a caller-supplied basePath/root instead of re-deriving cwd from the partial's dirname
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the obvious fix for sibling-include behaviour and would move the containment root, changing which paths are allowed

O8b_injection_room.sibling: watch-mode compile rebuilds the mjml2html options from options.config per file, a second place an include policy must be honoured
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already re-merges config for every file, so adding an override there is a believable maintainer change

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a '..' / startsWith check inside handleInclude only (or just flip ignoreIncludes to true there), leaving mjml2html unable to forward the flag and the CLI -v route and watch-mode include reader untouched

unverified: The published diff does not apply cleanly to the pinned tree: its mjml-core hunk targets 'export default async function mjml2html' around line 420 while the pinned file has the synchronous form at packages/mjml-core/src/index.js:32, and its parser hunk edits handleCssHtmlInclude, an identifier that does not exist anywhere at the pinned commit; the two fix commits each introduce ignoreIncludes in mjml-core from different bases. Treated as a behaviour spec, not a patch.
Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell available); estimated well under 5 MB from the 223-file tracked tree and the absence of node_modules, so tiny_repo is asserted from the file inventory only.

Whether the hidden tests require the exact denial contract (the literal '<!-- mj-include denied -->' comment and errors:[{type:'include-denied'}]) is unknown; nothing at the pinned commit produces or consumes it, and packages/mjml-validator/src/rules/errorAttr.js:10-17 only maps type 'include'.

Whether defaulting ignoreIncludes to true is part of the intended task behaviour is unknown: it changes documented behaviour (packages/mjml/README.md:128 documents filePath-driven includes) and the published fix had to edit the parser's own Include test to opt in.
